question: Two first-party AWS pages disagree on whether Bedrock AgentCore is on the Free plan: https://aws.amazon.com/free/ marks 'Amazon Bedrock AgentCore' as 'Paid plan exclusive', while https://docs.aws.amazon.com/accounts/latest/reference/supported-services-sign-up-new.html lists 'Amazon Bedrock Agent Core' among the services included in the Free Tier of the new AWS experience.
why: compute/aws-agentcore carries verdict trial-only and a free tier of the USD 200 new-customer credit; which plan may spend that credit on AgentCore decides whether the offer is reachable on the free plan
